text:
maria: Heads-up — we need NDv2 capacity reserved across two subscriptions for the new westus2 training cluster. Customer wants dedicated GPUs for compliance. Can someone confirm the steps and who to loop in at MSFT?

alex: +1. Two separate things: (1) quota increase for the SKU in each subscription, (2) capacity reservation (aka "capacity plan") if you need guaranteed nodes. Azure handles them differently.

maria: Great. Subscriptions and SKUs below, wanted to post here before filing tickets: 
```
subscription-a: 9f1b2c3d-aaaa-4b5c-9d1e-111111111111 -> request NDv2 quota to 20 (Standard_ND40rs_v2)
subscription-b: 2e4f6g8h-bbbb-4c5d-9e2f-222222222222 -> request NDv2 quota to 20 (Standard_ND40rs_v2)
requested region: westus2
window: provision by 2026-04-01
```

jonathan: For quota increases file an Azure Support "Quota" request in the portal and choose "Compute - GPU". For capacity reservation ask the rep for a "Capacity Reservation" order (sometimes called dedicated cluster request). It may require a separate sales channel.

priya: FYI cost implications: capacity reservations will likely be 30-40% higher committed cost vs spot/on-demand because it's reserved capacity. Do we have budget signoff? cc @sarah

sarah: We have preliminary approval but need exact cost estimate. maria, can you attach an expected QPS/throughput so we can pick right size? Also, prefer backups in eastus2 as fallback.

maria: Estimated steady-state: 16 GPUs active, 4 for spares/burst. Peak training windows 4–6 hours daily. Fallback region: eastus2.

alex: Filing guidance — open two portal support requests, include the subscription IDs, SKU, region, and cite planned start date. Set problem type to "Quota increase for VM family" and severity "Standard". If you need faster turnaround ask Azure rep to escalate to "Quota in next 48h".

maria: Filed tickets, got IDs: 
```
AZURE-2026-8345  (subscription-a)  — quota request created
AZURE-2026-8346  (subscription-b)  — quota request created
```

azure-support-bot: Update on AZURE-2026-8345: Support assigned. Engineer: rajesh-msft. ETA initial review 24h.

priya: Any chance to bundle both subs under one capacity reservation to save cost?

alex: Usually reservation is per-environment/region and tied to subscription billing. You can move resources with peering but billing remains per-sub. Bundling might require an enterprise agreement; talk to the Azure rep.

jonathan: If quota is slow, fallback plan: provision smaller ND/NC instances in eastus2 while we await reservation, or use burst on-demand NDv2 in the same region — but watch latency for data egress.

maria: Noted. I've pinged rajesh-msft: "We need guaranteed NDv2 capacity in westus2 by 2026-04-01 for customer X, please advise reservation path and cost."

azure-support-bot: Update on AZURE-2026-8346: Quota increased to 20 for SKU Standard_ND40rs_v2 in westus2 (provisioning pending).

sarah: Nice. maria, once both tickets land please add the final cost estimate and we can finalize PO. Also ensure we record reservation IDs in infra runbook.

maria: Will do. I'll post the final reservation/order numbers here and update the runbook under eng-infra docs. Thanks all :thumbsup:

alex: Quick checklist for the ticket description (copy/paste): 
```
- subscription id
- target SKU and quota number
- target region
- planned start date
- justification (dedicated cluster for customer with compliance needs)
- contact: maria@redwood.com, pager: +1-555-0100
```

maria: Copying checklist into both tickets now. Leaving this thread open for updates.

jonathan: If we hit "capacity exhausted" during provisioning, escalate to Rajesh and ask for "private capacity pool" option. It worked for us last year.

azure-support-bot: AZURE-2026-8345 -> Engineer says initial check shows available quota but needs approval. Next update within 12–24h.
